name: confidence-protocol
description: Turn coding work into clear claims backed by tests, reviews, and runtime evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Build simple code and prove that it works.
interface.longDescription: Adds a risk-aware coding workflow with explicit intent, proof obligations, adversarial review, clean tests, simplicity checks, safe diagnostics, and a concise confidence report.
defaultPrompt: Use the Confidence Protocol to build this and prove the main flow.
Use the Confidence Protocol to fix this bug with a fail-then-pass test.
Use the Confidence Protocol to review this risk and show what remains unknown.
